character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create an original, highly polished 2D pixel-art character for ShieldQuest, a cozy Singaporean urban life-simulation adventure game.

CHARACTER: Malay Singaporean male delivery rider, approximately 20–35 years old.

ART DIRECTION:
- Cozy polished pixel art, modern life-simulation game style.
- Detailed handcrafted sprite with soft shading and clean selective outlines.
- Slightly stylized but natural body proportions.
- Friendly, practical and readable design.

APPEARANCE:
- Medium-brown skin tone.
- Short dark hair.
- Practical casual delivery outfit.
- Branded-looking but generic delivery backpack.
- Comfortable trousers or shorts.
- Sporty shoes.
- Friendly but focused expression.

SINGAPOREAN IDENTITY:
- Recognisable everyday delivery rider in Singapore.
- Urban, practical, weather-appropriate clothing.
- Natural and respectful representation.

SPRITE REQUIREMENTS:
- Full-body standing character, transparent background.
- Orthogonal low top-down perspective.
- Consistent proportions and silhouette.
- No background, no text, no fantasy elements, no vehicle included.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET:
A polished and believable Singaporean delivery rider character for a cozy urban neighbourhood game.
